references.title: Steel Erection
key_requirements: Safety decking required to be installed below work
Connectors must have fall protection when working 2+ stories above lower level

references.title: Excavations
key_requirements: Competent person must classify soil before excavation
Shoring, sloping, or shielding required for excavations > 1.5m
Daily inspection required by competent person
Ladder access required for trenches > 1.2m deep
Surface water and groundwater must be controlled

references.reference: ILO C167 — Safety and Health in Construction Convention
references.title: International Construction Safety Convention
